reviews.title: No Communication, No Transparency, No Respect!
reviews.text:
I’ve been on Raya’s waitlist for more than 3.5 years‼️ Despite having 2 referrals, and there is no way to get information about what is happening with an application.

I have contacted their support so many times and received no response or any indication of why I am still waitlisted, whether my application is actually being reviewed, or whether I should expect to hear anything at all. Meanwhile, I regularly hear of people being accepted within hours or days, even without any referrals.

Keeping people in limbo for literally YEARS while providing zero transparency and virtually no customer service is ridiculous. Modern dating 🤣 If someone is not going to be accepted, just say so!

The whole system feels arbitrary, opaque and incredibly disrespectful towards prospective clients. A supposedly exclusive app should be capable of basic communication and customer service.

reviews.title: Racist and discriminatory app
reviews.text:
I’m a Black woman, and I was waitlisted for over a year despite having a public Instagram, an established career, interests, and referrals. I eventually had a white friend sign up, and she was approved in less than 24 hours despite having a private account, no bio, and around 100 followers.

I can’t speak for every Black applicant, but the contrast was hard to ignore. When two people with such different profiles receive completely different outcomes, it raises legitimate questions about how applicants are being evaluated and whether race plays a role in the selection process.

Yes, there are Black people on the app, but they’re the minority. My experience, combined with the inconsistency in who gets approved, makes it difficult not to question whether certain demographics are being preferentially selected.

If an app has a particular demographic it wants to cultivate, I’d rather they be transparent about that than leave people wondering why they continue to be waitlisted despite seemingly meeting the criteria.

They would show men from all over the world. Even though you pay, you can only see a certain number of members at a time. Feels like the user base is pretty small. Was contacted by a few men, but none of them ever tried to meet up and actually make a date. Was a waste of time.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.text: Honestly I was so excited to get approved for Raya. While the members are more attractive than other dating apps, most it shows are celebrities you’ll never have a chance of matching with, and it gives you the same people over and over again despite me traveling frequently. When you finally do match with someone, they rarely ever message and if they do just say “hey” or other generic lines. Honestly hinge is much better and more personable, even if you have to filter through a lot of less attractive men. It’s definitely more of an app people are only on just to say they’re on it, no one is looking for connections or dates. I had one date in three months of having Raya, compared to other apps where people actually know how to have a conversation and want to meet. Very disappointing. Not worth the $25 a month and definitely not worth anymore

reviews.title: All hype no dates
reviews.text: Very few matches, and I haven’t met anyone. It feels like people are on Raya just to be on Raya because It’s not easy to get accepted, so if you’re on Raya you’re immediately viewed special, like you’re part of some private club, yet very few people actually end up meeting. And I consider myself a good looking woman. There are many social media famous, attractive men and women on the app from all over the world, but if you want to focus on your local area, the app doesn’t allow you to change your settings. In fact, it doesn’t allow any settings at all. You just get random suggestions with no filters whatsoever. The app has more hype than functionality. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Waste of money!
reviews.text: The cheapest subscription is £20 per month, which means you see people from all over the world and can only view a certain number at a time. I didn’t mind only seeing a few people at a time as swiping through 100s can get overwhelming. But matching with people across the other side of the world seems crazy to me - who wants to actively start a long distance relationship?! Perhaps if you pay the £50 per month for an updated account you get more preferences. All in all I barely got any matches and didn’t see it as the premium experience it’s advertised as. Not a great calibre of people on there tbh

reviews.title: Not worth the money, especially if you don’t live in a big city
reviews.text: Raya was all jacked up to be some super exclusive dating app that would connect you with celebrities but it’s quickly become a platform for literally ANYONE to use. It will show you people all over the world, it will say “you’ve matched!” with someone you’ve never seen before, and outside of the occasional celebrity (which in most cases ends up being a sports player rather than the A-list ones we’re picturing), it will force you to look at people from the closest big city to you, even if it’s 50 miles away. Not worth it at all.

reviews.title: No Support
reviews.text: I was accepted into Raya on Halloween this year. Approximately 2 weeks later, I decided to move forward with my membership and pay. For whatever reason, my age is listed as 19 years old when I’m nearly 10 years older. Instagram has my age listed correctly, but Raya has no way to remediate age, so I emailed support in the app immediately — NO RESPONSE! I have emailed support nearly 5 times in the past 2 weeks with zero fix. My app is updated and my friend who is using Raya had received immediate assistance from support, but not me. Now I haven’t been using the app meaning that my matches are expiring. Why pay $25 for a broken app?

reviews.title: Limited choice and too large a net
reviews.text: i’ve been on this app for a month and only had three matches. zero dates. Minimal conversation. You get a very limited number of profiles to view a day, most you aren’t likely to meet as they live abroad . you are unable to see who you’ve liked once you’ve liked them. You have to wait hours to view more people. Dating is a numbers game and this app doesn’t give you the numbers to find the bonus. Lots of fake profiles.
